description_en: You can call GetInstanceTrendingReport to retrieve the trend report for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用GetInstanceTrendingReport获取指定实例的变化趋势报表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-instance-trending-report --instance-id ccc-test --start-time 1604639129000 --end-time 1604725528000 --media-type Audio --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceTrendingReport

parameters.help_en: Start UNIX timestamp. The default value is the start time of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed 7 days. The format is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳，默认是当天开始时间，最早为当前时间往前180天，开始和截止时间间隔不能超过7天，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End UNIX timestamp. The default value is the current time. The format is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间戳，默认是当前时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Media type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type
